profile.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited
profile.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, packages, tests, and sells integrated circuits and other semiconductor devices in Taiwan, China, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Japan, the United States, and internationally. It provides various wafer fabrication processes, such as processes to manufacture complementary metal- oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) logic, mixed-signal, radio frequency, embedded memory, bipolar CMOS mixed-signal, and others. network_links.note: 100% monopoly supplier of EUV & High-NA lithography (~$380M/machine; TSMC accounts for ~30–35% of ASML's ~$30B annual revenue)

network_links.name: Applied Materials
network_links.note: Largest wafer fab equipment supplier for PVD/CVD deposition, CMP & CoWoS advanced packaging (~18% of AMAT revenue)

network_links.name: Lam Research
network_links.note: Critical plasma etch, atomic layer deposition & TSV packaging equipment for 3nm/2nm & CoWoS (~16% of Lam revenue)

network_links.name: KLA Corporation
network_links.note: Dominant optical/e-beam wafer inspection & mask metrology systems for N3/N2 yield management (~20% of KLA revenue)

network_links.name: Alphabet
network_links.note: Fabricates 100% of Google's custom Trillium (TPU v6) AI accelerators on N4/N3 nodes

network_links.name: NVIDIA
network_links.note: NVIDIA (NVDA): 100% of H100/Blackwell/Rubin wafer fabrication (N4P/N3) & CoWoS packaging (~$38B+/yr COGS flow; NVDA is ~12% of TSMC revenue)

network_links.name: Amazon
network_links.note: Fabricates 100% of AWS Trainium2 AI chips and Graviton4 ARM server CPUs

network_links.name: Broadcom
network_links.note: Fabricates Broadcom custom AI XPUs (Google TPU, Meta MTIA) and Tomahawk 5 51.2T networking switches (~$8B+/yr)

network_links.name: Tesla
network_links.note: Fabricates Tesla Hardware 4 / AI5 autonomous driving Dojo & vehicle inference silicon

network_links.name: Advanced Micro Devices
network_links.note: 100% of AMD EPYC Zen-5 CPUs and Instinct MI300/MI350 GPUs are fabricated & packaged at TSMC (~$7B+/yr)

network_links.name: Intel
network_links.note: Outsourced N3B wafer fabrication for Intel Lunar Lake, Arrow Lake & GPU tiles

network_links.name: Marvell Technology
network_links.note: Fabricates Marvell custom cloud AI accelerators and 800G/1.6T Pam4 optical DSPs (~$2B+/yr)
